card.name: Leading digit 1 or 2 in numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit (mostly 1 or 2) of a multi-digit number or decimal in drug-label text. It appears in trial counts, section cross-references and confidence intervals.

modes.label: Leading digit of a count
modes.description: The digit 1 starting a number of trials or patients, with more digits following.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: The digit 2 right after an opening parenthesis, starting a label section number such as 2.3.

modes.label: Statistic or dose value
modes.description: A leading digit in a confidence interval or a dose amount.

card.writes: It seems to push the next token toward more digit or number pieces and away from spaces and line breaks.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number when more digits are still to come, such as a patient count or a section number.
